name: lecturedoc2
description: LectureDoc2 - the presentation framework. Browser runtime only: the CSS and the ES modules a finished deck loads. Everything that runs in Node at authoring time lives in `lecturedoc2-author`.
//: Browser code is bundled into `dist/` by build.js; that is what a deck loads and what `files` publishes. Bundling is what allows LectureDoc2 to have runtime dependencies at all -- a browser cannot resolve a bare specifier, and before the build step every shared library had to be copied into src/ by hand.
